steps.title: Step loop
steps.desc: ReactLoopAgent.step() runs the model request inside an inner while(true) so a failure can retry without leaving the step.

steps.title: Stream request
steps.desc: buildRequest() assembles the call; the loop streams chunks until assembler.finish resolves.

steps.title: Request fails
steps.desc: finish.kind is error or aborted, so the loop fires the agent/request-error waterfall while the turn signal is still live.

steps.title: Plugin decides
steps.desc: dsh-llm-retry reads retryPolicy and returns {kind:'retry'} without next(), short-circuiting the waterfall.

steps.title: Retry new step
steps.desc: continue rebuilds and resends from durable history; every retry opens a new step in the same turn.

steps.title: Terminal error
steps.desc: No listener retries: the default handler returns undefined and the loop throws LlmError, closing step and turn.
